title: [CI] Download only selected UI test folders in slim test jobs

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The corrected Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Pester 3.4 fixture passed all ten cases, with child exit zero and the exclusive lock released afterward. That result does not verify Azure template expansion, real artifact-download matching, transfer or path preservation, or end-to-end UI behavior. The exact fork head remains open and non-draft, with no GitHub status contexts observed. Azure CLI has no signed-in account and its DevOps extension is absent, so no pipeline definition or queue permission could be verified. A pipeline owner must confirm the existing definition, YAML path and manual queue access for the pinned fork branch before any authorized validation run. Nothing was installed or queued; the ended unmatched Copilot request is not convergence.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
